mainEntity.name: Is building an in-law suite better than assisted living?

acceptedAnswer.text: A multigenerational home addition provides private, comfortable space while keeping family close, but it requires balancing upfront investment against family dynamics. Building onto your home increases usable living space and can enhance long-term property appeal. It also eliminates costly monthly assisted living fees while keeping loved ones nearby. However, it requires an upfront construction investment, alters your property's yard footprint, and requires adjustments to household routines. Evaluating family caregiving capacity alongside the financial commitment helps determine if an in-law suite is the right long-term choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: An in-law suite keeps family close and builds home equity without recurring facility fees, but it requires upfront construction costs and personal caregiving time.
